SELECT DATE_FORMAT(check_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') as hour, app_id, app_code, COUNT(*) as total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN check_result = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as success_count, AVG(response_time) as avg_response_time FROM health_check_history WHERE check_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND app_id = #{appId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(check_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00'), app_id, app_code ORDER BY hour
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM health_check_history WHERE check_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
